risks.risk: Whether the machine actually runs smoothly (motor, belt/drive, timing) and stitches correctly.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running and sewing a straight seam on fabric (showing feed moving and thread tension).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts (needle, bobbin case, presser foot, belt, foot pedal) or damaged needle area.
risks.proof: Photos of: needle + presser foot, bobbin/bobbin case, foot pedal, and underside/belt area (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown parts risk (worst case: may require parts).

risks.risk: Electrical issues (power cable, switch, pedal wiring) or weak motor.
risks.proof: Photo of the power plug/cable and switch, plus a video showing it starting from the pedal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical condition unknown (worst case: electrical repair needed).

risks.risk: Type mismatch (industrial/lockstitch vs other) affecting what it can sew and compatibility with your use.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine label/plate (model/type) and the stitch mechanism area; or a close-up of the top cover/label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic industrial sewing machine with unknown exact type.

proof_requests: Video of it sewing (start-to-finish) on fabric, showing feed and even stitches.
Close-up photos of needle, presser foot, bobbin/bobbin case, and foot pedal.
Photo of the power cable/plug and any label/plate with model/type/serial number.
response.reason: The photo identifies a FLY sewing machine, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' and 'good conditions' claims are not verifiable from a single non-operational image. Request a short sewing video and key part/electrical photos before pricing confidently.
